messages:
Eli: tiny celebration drop: we just surpassed 2M daily requests for the first time. drumroll? :drum: :doughnut:
Maya: whoa, congrats team!! donuts at 3pm? :doughnut: :coffee:
Sam: i'm in for donuts. also proposing tiny engraved plaques for the plant shelf that say 'served with care' lol. :seedling: :laughing:
deploy-bot: deploy note: rollout-2026-03-22 completed. no regressions detected.
ops-bot: metrics snapshot: daily_requests=2,012,434; p95_latency=115ms; error_rate=0.03%. Autoscaler handled spike smoothly.
Eli: plan: donuts + 2-min micro-shoutouts at 3pm at the kitchen table. react with :doughnut: if you're coming in person, or :house: if remote and want a care package.
Maya: :doughnut: count me in. i'll bring a tiny hand-drill for DIY plaque hangers.
Sam: :house: please add a sticker to the care packages. also can someone photograph the tiny plaque mounting process for #watercooler?
Eli: yes to photos. bonus points for dramatic drumroll clip. :video_camera:
Maya: i'll make a 6s slo-mo donut dunk vid. low-effort hype. :popcorn:
Sam: cheers all. quick shoutout to the optimizer change last sprint 1 that shaved latency during the peak. big win. :raised_hands:
Eli: agreed. short & sweet at 3pm. bring your donut faces. :smile:
